subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should OpenClaw treat a multi-user Telegram DM bot using the default shared `session.dmScope: main` as expected configuration risk, or change defaults, doctor guidance, or Telegram safety behavior for this class of incident?
rationale: The diagnostics prove a real burst but not the content or exact cross-chat contamination, while current code intentionally supports shared DM sessions by default and partial abort/dedupe fixes do not settle semantic runaway-output policy.

options.title: Keep as manual incident tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open for maintainer review of Telegram DM scoping, replay evidence, and semantic runaway-output policy before any automated repair.

options.title: Route to support/config docs
options.body: Treat the incident as expected shared-DM configuration risk if maintainers confirm the reporter should isolate DMs with `session.dmScope`.

options.title: Sponsor a product change
options.body: Define a new default, doctor warning, or semantic guard and use this issue as the owning tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep as manual incident tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open for maintainer review of Telegram DM scoping, replay evidence, and semantic runaway-output policy before any automated repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses routing defaults, docs, and product behavior, and this handle has the strongest sampled history across those surfaces.
